knowledge_units.context_summary: The EcoEvoApps project aims to bridge the gap between theoretical and empirical ecology and evolutionary biology (EEB) by providing interactive tools for mathematical models. The authors identify barriers to integration, including the perceived difficulty of equation-heavy papers and a lack of pedagogical focus on theoretical models compared to statistics or programming. The paper introduces an open-source R package and website offering interactive Shiny apps to simulate fundamental EEB models.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The EcoEvoApps project provides an open-source R package and website containing interactive Shiny apps for simulating fundamental ecology and evolutionary biology models. The platform aims to bridge theoretical and empirical research by allowing users to explore model structures and outcomes, with a core set of apps available in multiple languages.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The ecoevoapps R package provides functions for simulating and visualizing ecological model dynamics, including specific run_ and plot_ functions. It includes vignettes for customizing app deployments and running models directly in R. The package serves as a gateway for users to implement mathematical models at the command line.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The MacArthur-Rosenzweig model demonstrates that high prey carrying capacity leads to unstable oscillations, whereas low values allow for stable persistence. Classroom surveys at UCLA and the University of Missouri indicate that interactive Shiny apps significantly improve student confidence and understanding of ecological models.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The EcoEvoApps project received exempt status from the Institutional Review Boards of UCLA and MU. The authors argue that simulation-based tools like EcoEvoApps lower barriers to theoretical models in ecology and evolutionary biology by providing open-source, R-based interactive apps. Future development plans include adding evolutionary biology models and creating new lesson plans for educators.
